excerpt: Global stock markets and indices showed mixed trends, with European markets advancing and Asian markets fluctuating due to geopolitical tensions and economic data. Major indices like the S&P 500 and Dow Jones hit record highs. Oil prices dropped amid hopes for a U.S.-Iran deal.
